email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Sales and Marketing Assistant (Digital Marketing Specialist) role at Jobat, supporting the international medical-sector company in Dilbeek. With hands-on experience in digital campaign execution, content creation, and website management, I am confident I can help translate marketing strategy into impactful local initiatives across the Benelux.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I develop and coordinate digital campaigns across social media, newsletters, and websites, ensuring content is engaging and relevant. My technical background allows me to work efficiently with suppliers and internal teams on operational marketing tasks.

I am eager to bring my skills to a company that values innovation, quality, and collaboration in the medical sector. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Sales and Marketing Assistant (Digital Marketing Specialist) position at Jobat, supporting the international medical-sector company based in Dilbeek. The opportunity to implement digital marketing campaigns and support local marketing initiatives across the Benelux aligns closely with my experience and my interest in the medical sector.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have developed and coordinated digital campaigns across social media, newsletters, and websites. I create engaging content tailored to target audiences, manage CMS platforms such as WordPress and WooCommerce, and ensure that online product information and promotional activities are accurate and up to date. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. I also manage Shopify stores, maintaining product catalogues and publishing blog content.

Performance analysis is a core part of my work. I regularly monitor campaign performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs, report on KPIs, and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness. My technical background in front-end development and automation allows me to coordinate with suppliers and internal teams efficiently, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.

I am drawn to this role because it combines digital campaign execution with local activation in a collaborative, international environment. I am eager to contribute to a company that values innovation, quality, and customer focus, and I am confident that my skills in content, CMS management, and performance analysis will support your commercial objectives.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
